parts.text: Outline the attributes of food and beverage service staff.

items.text: The quality of food and beverage service offered greatly influence the meal experience. Discuss any five technical writing skills required by food and beverage service staff.

parts.text: Examine any five factors that influence the choice of food and drinks in the restaurant.
Explain any five advantages of using disposables.

items.text: Food service areas and the kitchen should be well connected to enhance efficiency. Examine any five back of house service areas in terms of functions, requirements and equipment.

parts.text: Describe any five order taking systems.
Enumerate five uses of a service plate.
